name: Leo Walter
source: Leo is the upperclassman who comes from a wealthy, famous chef family. Thanks to his culinary pedigree, he was brought up with the best food the world has to offer, evident by his occasional patronizing demeanor. While he is admired by female and male classmates alike, he doesn't give the attention a second thought as he's used to the spotlight.
